feeds.title: The Wild Geese Blog
feeds.description: The Wild Geese was established in the fall of 1997 as an online magazine to share The Epic History and Heritage of the Irish with the tens of millions of individuals of Irish ancestry found worldwide. Their social network is a leading Internet destination for those looking to explore and celebrate Irish history and heritage, in the words of William Butler Yeats wherever green is worn. Get into their blog and learn more about the latest news, articles, videos, and more.

feeds.title: Wild Irish Walks Blog
feeds.description: Wild Irish Walks was set up to provide information and advice for people who are interested in getting out into the beautiful countryside that we are lucky to have in Ireland. The Blog section of this website provides loads of details of what to expect for a wide range of different walks across the island of Ireland. Visit the blog and learn more about his experiences, articles, and more on Irish wildlife.

feeds.title: Wildacres Nature Reserve Blog
feeds.description: In East County Wicklow, close to the picturesque Brittas Bay and just a few minutes from the sleepy rural community of Redcross, sits Wildacres, a Nature Reserve, honey farm, and biodiversity teaching experience. You may select from a range of interesting, pleasurable, and educational nature-focused excursions, hikes, workshops, and courses there, in addition to open days and an exciting annual Honey Harvest Day in the fall. Explore more about biodiversity protection, restoration, education, engaging guided tours, walks, workshops, courses, and more from their blog.

feeds.title: Fota Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Fota Wildlife Park, part of the Zoological Society of Ireland, is located on 100 acres at Fota Island 10km east of Cork City, and has an annual attendance of many visitors. Its vision is to inspire people to understand and conserve the biodiversity of our natural world. Go through their blog and learn more about their programs, events, latest news, education, resources, conservation, and more.

feeds.title: Ireland's Wildlife
feeds.description: Ireland's Wildlife is an online resource and community for everyone interested in the wilder side of Ireland. Their mission is to promote the enjoyment, appreciation, and conservation of Ireland's rich natural heritage for everyone. Get closer to the wild side of Ireland with great articles, reviews, species profiles, wildlife experiences, and much more through their blog.

feeds.title: Irish Wildlife Trust Blog
feeds.description: The Irish Wildlife Trust is a non-government organization and charity founded in 1979. It aims to conserve wildlife and the habitats it depends on throughout Ireland while encouraging a greater understanding and appreciation of the natural world and the need to protect it. Its mission is to create a better future for Ireland's biodiversity by motivating and supporting people to take action to protect and restore biodiversity. Check out their blog and learn more about the latest news, events, campaigns, media, and more related to wildlife.

feeds.title: Rewilding.ie Blog
feeds.description: Rewilding.ie aims to help people build their connection with the nature of Ireland - both on an individual level and together as part of a community. Their project focuses on putting pollinators first. They also work to support beekeepers who love nature and are seeking to support the vision of a wilder, healthier island of Ireland. Visit their blog and learn more about their products, services, articles, and much more.

feeds.title: Wild Ireland
feeds.description: Wild Ireland offers sanctuary to many animals that have been persecuted and hunted to extinction in Ireland. They aim to inspire young people to be the conservationists of the future by educating their guests on local and global conservation issues. Their ongoing mission is to rescue and rehabilitate animals needing sanctuary and help restore their natural environment through native planting. Dive into their blog and learn more about their plans, upcoming events, news, articles, and more on Ireland's lost wildlife.

feeds.title: Secret Valley Wildlife Park
feeds.description: Secret Valley Wildlife Park is the only fully licensed zoo and Wildlife Park in the South East. They want to educate their visitors while giving them an entertaining experience leading to a greater respect for animals around the world. They have everything from animal handling to keeper talks with plenty of hands-on activities with their animals for you to enjoy. Visit their blog and learn more about the latest news, experiences, education, and more on wildlife.

feeds.title: Cabragh Wetlands
feeds.description: At Cabragh Wetlands, they are committed to the three-fold vision of conservation, education, and recreation. It was registered in 1993 in an effort to save a vast area of wetland habitats from destruction. Check out their blog and learn more about their events, latest news, exhibitions, education, gallery, and more.

feeds.title: Gardens for Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Gardens for Wildlife is a family, Irish company based in Trim Co. Meath, established in 2017 by Tomas and Monika Novak to manufacture Grow It Bio organic plant feeds and soil conditioners and to promote organic growing. They offer a range of products that match their eco and sustainability ethos. They started to focus on making the garden more wildlife-friendly. Take a walk through their blog and learn more about resources, tips for organic gardening, bird feeding, wildflower meadows, and more.
